context_branches.topic: Required teaching printer and logical lines
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Source explicitly requires WORKBOOK.PRS in the program directory for lessons16/17. NEWSTEXT.WKB uses Helvetica10pt; logical printed lines can exceed80 editing cells. Single Home/Right shifts by a screen section; double Home with arrows reaches logical ends, but on a short headline stops at that shorter end. Actual font metrics and display profile remain prerequisites.

context_branches.topic: Empty figure box and overlay branch
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Create an empty Figure, Page anchor/current page, Full Page vertical position, and WrapNo. Source says WrapYes would put the border alone on page1 and text onpage2; WrapNo overlays border and articles, which are not contents of the box. Graphics hardware affects preview availability; printing is the offered alternative. This is not observed executable behavior.

context_branches.topic: Margin owner order determines border geometry
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Place new1.25in margins after Figure owner and before Sales so only text insets. If before Figure, both border and text would use new margins. The expected quarter-inch whitespace is resource/order dependent. Enter from Line to main Format is a context-specific menu return, not arbitrary text insertion.

context_branches.topic: Column width source arithmetic mismatch
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Prose endpoints1.25–4 and4.5–7.25 imply2.75in widths with0.5in gap; the same paragraph says3.25in. The visually checked diagram shows those endpoints. Retain both assertions and the mismatch; do not normalize into a guessed default geometry or target executable expectation.

context_branches.topic: Define versus On and column status
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Column Define and Column On are distinct native owners. Col1 status applies between On/Off and identifies active column. Moving On down by two returns moves column starts, while preceding definition remains. Optional100%/200% views are independent preview branches.

context_branches.topic: Masthead outside column flow
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Insert space at Columns On, center HALVA Herald before On, then add a horizontal Graphics Line and another return. This is a native graphics owner, not character line drawing; masthead and line stay outside the columns.

context_branches.topic: Column-relative movement and Hard Page
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Repeat/Esc then Down passes Columns On. Inside columns GoToDown reaches column bottom, HardPage advances to next column, and HomeLeft/Right stay within its margins. GoToLeft crosses to previous column; HomeUp/Down still address page extent. These context changes differ from ordinary page navigation. Exact default Repeat handling is not generalized beyond this source instruction.

context_branches.topic: Newsletter save identity
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Save new learner NEWSLTR and decline application exit; this output becomes WB17 input. Keep original NEWSTEXT.WKB and that learner revision distinct, with all inserted native owners and selected resources bound for later execution.

context_branches.topic: Attribute menus and resource limits
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Size menu lists Superscript,Subscript,Fine,Small,Large,VeryLarge,ExtraLarge; Appearance lists Bold,Underline,DoubleUnderline,Italic,Outline,Shadow,SmallCaps,Redline,Strikeout. Merely viewing lists does not execute all entries. Fonts/printer capabilities govern actual realization: distinct requested sizes may map to the same font,18pt may leave no larger family member, and bold can use darker fonts or repeated strikes.

context_branches.topic: Paired attributes, reselect and repeated headline exercise
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: ExtraLarge and Shadow surround masthead with paired owners; open Margin/Spacing owners instead persist until reset. Block then GoTo twice reselects the same range. Bold/Large repeat for Training Classes and Seminars and HALVA Goes Retail, including GoToRight for second column. Shadow source expectation uses offset repeated text. All exact ranges/native nesting/print metrics remain pending.

context_branches.topic: Physical mouse and font-menu alternatives
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Two explicit left-drag routes select masthead/headline instead of keyboard Block. Headline alternative also selects Font Appearance Bold, while BoldF6 and Font appearance menu are distinct routes to same requested attribute. Source says Underline also has both routes; it is not another numbered exercise. Physical host endpoints/focus/cancel remain unrun.

context_branches.topic: Base font replacement, deletion and Restore
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Roman10pt changes body and attribute family selection, not just one text run. Delete its owner to compare Helvetica then restore the same owner at the same gap via Undelete. Font fallback may choose another available typeface when matching family unavailable. Actual PRS/font resources, deletion provenance and native save/reopen/print remain required.

context_branches.topic: Linked WPG and paragraph anchor
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: GRAPH.WPG changes Figure contents Empty to Graphic. Paragraph anchor keeps graph with first paragraph, default right position wraps text on its left; editing shows a placeholder rather than the rendered graph. No private WPG was opened; registered metadata is not a decoding, availability or print witness.

context_branches.topic: Graph reflow and old Hard Page
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Adding graph spills first article to second column; existing HardPage pushes later articles to page2. Delete that exact old boundary to refill page1. Earlier WB16 HardPage behavior and later changed pagination must not be treated as inconsistent commands or equivalent states.

context_branches.topic: Figure edit and nested caption context
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Edit figure2, set vertical offset0.5in, remove supplied caption number with Backspace, then use Bold/Small and exact caption text. Caption editing resembles header/footer but is a separate context. Exit twice returns to body. Preview200%/Down four times inspects text above/left/below; no generic wrap algorithm inferred from one illustrated case.

context_branches.topic: Copying figure owner inside columns
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Copy Figure1 owner as Block, paste at second-page beginning and observe new figure3 numbering. Because this insertion is inside Newspaper flow, FullPage frames a column. Original figure before ColumnsOn frames physical page. Preserve figure ownership, numbering and native copy payload, not just visual similarity.

context_branches.topic: Undelete figure into repeated header
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Delete figure3 then figure1, create HeaderA EveryPage and Restore most recent deleted original border there. Creating a fresh equivalent box is an explicit alternative. Header-hosted figure repeats outside Newspaper column scope. Delete history crossing body/header and page2 presence are required observations, not assumed by a working primitive.

context_branches.topic: Header spacing and replacement margin code
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Header introduces spacing and uses later top-margin setting; replace top1.25 with1 while retaining bottom1.25 viaEnter. Delete obsolete1.25/1.25 owner only after new owner exists. Source expects balanced border spacing; exact order and header/figure geometry remain pending.

context_branches.topic: Special marker versus literal caret and style/position
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Ctrl+B inserts one special page-number marker, deleted as a unit and reinserted. Literal caret plusB is two printable characters and does not substitute a number. Page Number Style and Position create separate owners; changing style need not change position. Page prefix plus actual numbers inspected on both pages.

context_branches.topic: Own-printer preview, print and portability
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Save NEWSLTR first. Optional choose own printer then preview or print; absent graphics/larger fonts can prevent requested appearance. Source portability branch saves on one printer and retrieves/prints on another supported5.1 printer. No actual printer/font/resource swap, output or native roundtrip occurred here.

context_branches.topic: Initial outline diagram and eight-level limit
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Primary introductory diagram shows four required levels, while prose permits up to eight. OUTLINE.WKB supplies title/initial definition. Four levels used later do not qualify every eight-level limit or all definition encodings. Final diagram is separately visually transcribed below.

context_branches.topic: Automatic paragraph numbers and Tab semantics
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: OutlineOn native owner and status enable Enter to insert automatic paragraph numbers. Tab/ShiftTab change numbering level and indentation; F4 adds a distinct heading indent. Enter stays at current level; ShiftTab returns to level1 and anotherEnter creates section spacing. Printed Roman/letter glyphs are generated from numbers, not literal typed labels.

context_branches.topic: Copy family scope and Typeover
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Level1 family includes heading and all subordinate headings until next level1. Copy initially highlights above original, arrows relocate preview, Enter commits below. Typeover replaces copied headings; WordLeft counts and CtrlEnd remove residual text. Return to Insert mode is required final state. Source does not specify finite Cancel-copy sequence; refusal/cancel remains pending.

context_branches.topic: Renumbering and subordinate family deletion
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Insert level2 before existing siblings then scroll to updateA/B toB/C; add two level3 descendants. Delete Family highlights only that level2 root and its descendants, not remaining siblings/othersections. Dialog shows No by default and numbered route choosesYes. No/Cancel behavior and untouched native bytes still need execution.

context_branches.topic: Outline Off owner boundary and status
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: OutlineOff ends Enter/Tab automatic behavior for following body. Status turns off to its right, reappears on Off owner or inside outline. Caret-gap boundary must be captured; it is not a global preference or proof every command context is identical.

context_branches.topic: Paragraph, Legal and Bullets definitions
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Sequential Define choices and Screen/Enter reformat compare Paragraph,Legal,Bullets. Legal attaches previous levels; others defaultNo. Screen/Enter is reformat here, distinct from Window sizing in WB12. Starting-number,AttachPreviousLevel,EnterInserts,AutoAdjust and all eight-level cells pictured are unselected leads, not silently executed variants.

context_branches.topic: User-defined bullet deletion and definition cleanup
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Delete twice removes first-level bullet; reformat then delete three older definition owners before removing current definition withYes to recover originalOutline. Optional Bold/extra spacing presentation headings are prose exercise, not numbered. Exact deletion order and fallback to preceding definition require native witness.

context_branches.topic: Open outline style and per-level code editor
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Create Indented with description Indented paragraph numbers. Source chooses Open because it inserts number+indent; Paired supports font/attribute scope but is unselected. Each Codes editor contains supplied number, with Style status. Level1 adds trailingIndent; level2 adds one leadingTab; guidedstep12 adds two/three leadingTabs for levels3/4, each with trailingIndent. No extra numbering owner should be invented.

context_branches.topic: Select style and expand owner
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Select Indented, insert ParagraphNumberDefinition and Screen/Enter reformat existing automatic numbers into per-level Open Style owners. Cursor on an owner expands contents (number+indent); old standaloneF4 indents are still separate and need removal. Embedded style data and its document ownership are distinct from an external style-library file.

context_branches.topic: Block-limited code replacement
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Block the outline from above first heading toend; ReplaceNoConfirm searches F4 Indent token with empty replacement usingF2twice. Source says only Indent codes in selected text are removed, leaving indent embedded in style. Scope must preserve style bodies, text, definitions and outside selection; a green plain-text replacement is insufficient.

context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Numbered steps create third level1 heading The Next Fifty Years and level2 Expanding Markets. Unnumbered instruction requires remaining nine diagram entries through levels2–4. They are individually retained as source diagram entries below, not newly allocated runtime IDs. Source diagram capitalization differs in places from numbered text; exact future input must retain provenance rather than silently normalize.

context_branches.topic: Mistake recovery and native style persistence
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: On mistakes, Backspace deletes Outline Style owner and hard return, thenEnter starts again. Save learner OUTLINE distinct fromOUTLINE.WKB; source says created outline-style list is saved with document for later edit/delete. Native producer/reopen and retained style contents must establish that claim; metadata or plain text alone cannot.
